title: Dispatch
description: data of: dispatch.py --json. Which of tonight's queued steps would go next now, until when, and the order every queued step was offered in with its reasons (docs/observing-plan-spec.md, Phase 4). Reads only; the runner chooses with [plan] dispatch on.

next.description: The step's id, or null when none can start now.

until.description: Unix seconds it must end by: the next protected start less its setup.

wait_s.description: With no step now: seconds until the next protected step's setup begins.
